objections.text: The single hand-derived case already supplies DeliveryRun '' and RunPosition NULL on the same customer and compares both projected values. A01 repeats that exact NULL-versus-empty mechanism with a reduced copy of the same reference data.
objections.resolution: A01 now contrasts an empty name from an existing buying-group/contact row with NULL from a nullable foreign key in the same output columns, and reverses the DeliveryRun/RunPosition NULL-empty arrangement. These mechanisms are distinct from the hand-derived projection-only pair.

objections.text: The hand-derived case already keeps a customer whose category, primary contact, delivery method and city all point to missing rows, and its customer rows already share the default phone number. A02 repeats both the LEFT JOIN and non-key-tie conditions.
objections.resolution: A02 now uses valid nullable foreign keys only, crosses primary and alternate contacts to expose a wrong self-join, and ties phone, fax, and website values across three rows. It no longer repeats dangling required references.
